reviews.comment: In all seriousness, Dr. K treats you like a child. She is extremely condescending and doesn't teach. She purely reads off slides and expects her students to just magically know the content. 0/10 would never take or reccomd this class again
Tough class with lots of time wasted
After attending a meeting with her, not even a class, I can say this lady is the worst. So condescending, don't take her unless you want to have the worst day of your life every class.
i love her guys, i looked both ways before crossing the road so i can see her in class

i didn't even take a class with her, i just had one meeting with her and it was so bad that i had to leave a review. she talks over time, cant lecture, and speaks in a massively condescending tone. i cannot stress enough to everyone to avoid taking her under any circumstances

During lecture she just read off the slides. Show up to class for your groupmates, and teach the python to yourself. Do the all the Zybooks you can, its good help. The lectures are NOTHING compared to the test or quizzes, all test averages were sub 70, and no curve was given for my class. Respectfully find someone else.

Prepare for a very annoying semester. This class is pass fail and is only one hour yet be prepared to put in more work than your 3-4 hour classes outside of lecture. There are multiple team and solo assignments due every week. Dr. K talks to us like we are toddlers, and yells into the mic for over an hour straight. Pure headache avoid this class!!!

you guys will never believe this but she was my principles of engineering teacher in 8th grade. she made fun of a kid so bad that she got fired for it. seems like she has not changed at all! i cant believe shes teaching here now skull

The most annoying class combined with a very condescending, and unbearable teaching experience. All the assignments are overly complicated for no reason a class that is genuinely a total waste of time and energy.

reviews.comment: First of all this class is just a money making scheme by the university. But Professor Schaefer makes it so more difficult than it should be. But it's pass fail so you don't have to put a lot of effort in. She talks like a preschool teacher, and gives extraordinarily vague instructions. And she'll cold call people like this is middle school too.

Workload feels much heavier than it should. She is extremely condescending towards students and due dates are followed very strictly, with zero regard for submission errors. Overall, the class feels unnecessarily frustrating for a simple developmental course.

The professor's teaching style is not geared towards college students; it is geared towards K-9 students, and the class sometimes lacks energy and engagement. However, the course has positive aspects, and with some improvements, it could be more enjoyable and beneficial for students.

I genuinely dreaded attending this class. She treats you like a pre-k student and her lectures are boring. She mainly reads off of slides and adds nothing of value. If I didn't have to show up to class the rating would be higher but attendance is mandatory so you'll have to tough it out and force yourself to listen to her.

She's not the worst at lecturing, just not great. You can get about the same information just reading the homework articles thoroughly. She offers less extra credit and doesn't make some quizzes completion grades like some profs did. She assigns groups based on a survey to level out coding experience. Definitely tough though.

Treats the class like it is a 4 hour course. Runs the class like it is middle school, and talks to all students in a condescending tone. While this class is worth absolutely nothing, it is equal in work load to some of my Math and Chemistry classes.

Thought I'd throw in my two cents as someone who had coding experience before and whose teammates had none. My teammates found her difficult to learn from. I had to teach them when we met for labs outside of class. Unless you have someone willing to teach in her stead, I'd take someone else. Do hw during lectures if you can't listen to her
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Coding languages are generally self taught. I came in with no coding experience, and I got by just enough to get an A. Just get all the homework and other grades and don't bomb the exam too badly. The prof was alright for me, but don't count on her to learn much.

Honestly I took python in highschool so it wasnt that hard. Coding is mostly self taught anyway only syntax is what u learn what to do then you apply it. Now on to the professor, just wow! She inspired me so much. Very condescending indeed. I asked her about something and she just looked at me like i was hitler. Also im 90% we were grouped by race.

Schaefer doesn't know how to teach, and if you're going into this class with no coding experience, it is extremely difficult to learn. I had 4 years of Java entering this class, and its the only reason I got an A. Schaefer is incredibly rude when you ask her questions, and makes you feel stupid for being confused. Don't take her if you can help it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's an alright professor. The exams are very difficult because of time restraints in my opinion. It's easy to finish with a B in her class but hard to finish with an A. DO ALL THE EXTRA CREDIT!

class was easy with python experience, otherwise went a bit fast. isnt a class where quality of teacher matters much if you know python since thats all the class is. boring lectures but overall the class isnt difficult just annoying. she seems to try her best but sometimes acts like students are little kids and takes a while to say simple things.

It's tradition for me to check her rate my professor at least once a semester. I took her in Fall 2023, and I thought I was the only one who didn't like her. She still treats students as if they were in Junior High, and it seems she still belittles them for asking questions during her lectures. Take Aitor Cruzado instead. He is amazing!!!

Schaefer cannot teach to saver her life. She talks to u as if you're an elementary student and can't even solve or explain her own problems. Reads off of slides so try not to fall asleep. Going to ur TA's office hours definitely helped though as they understand the material better and are more relaxed and understand the stress of ETAM

She has a very difficult class to teach. But I think she did a good job, especially because it is a lot of students first time taking a coding class. Super understanding and gave exemptions for absences.

Quit hating on Schaefer!! I was very scared when I initially saw her reviews but she isn't that bad as a professor. The way that she organizes when things are due (assignments due sunday then quiz monday) ensures that you have coding experience for the upcoming quiz. She tries to engage the class but everyone's too sleepy, but she tries.

Dr. Schaefer is a blessing to this campus. Her class was the highlight of my week every week. I considered q dropping the class just to take it again because she's that awesome. The hate on here is because people can't handle getting mogged by her amazing outfits.

I loved it! She gets a lot of hate but I really enjoyed her humor and funny outfits! Just do your zybooks with purposeful intent. What you put in is what you get out. If you're failing- that's on you because I promise if you use your resources, you will have success.

Her lectures were always weird and pretty useless. When it came to test review she couldn't even solve some of the questions and just sat there saying um. Also for the last exam worth 25% of our grade she was really slow at checking us in so we got 25 minutes less than other classes making it extremely stressful to finish, all because of her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I think most of the bad reviews about her personality are mostly written by guys because she was a very sweet person if you got to know her. Yes, she is not that good at teaching the class and the TAs and TA office hours are astronomically better than whatever goes on in her class. I had no prior coding experience and still made an A it's possible.

DONT Take Her!! She is so demeaning and talks to everyone like they are babies. The only good part about this class was the TAs they were pretty useful and accessible. I have heard other professors grade better and are nicer about extra credit and curving at the end of the year. If you cant get a different professor, then good luck.

excessively long lectures that re-explain the material from zybook and repeats herself unnecessarily. I had better luck searching through the zybook or google than learning anything during class. occasional times where she didn't know how to solve the coding problems or she was doing them incorrectly. most work was done outside class
I stopped looking when I was crossing the street, hoping a car would hit me on the way to her class.
she is a terrible professor and never answered my questions.

reviews.comment: She doesnt even know how to code

Not very helpful when it comes to actually learning the course. Half the time, she didn't know how to even solve most of the problems. Not qualified for this course at all. Barely got a B, mostly ETAM's fault but also hers.

Took class pass fail so didn't care. She speaks like you are 4 and has weird ways of running her class like it's a kindergarten class. Mandatory participation quizzes which are just completion but require a code you only get at the end of the lectures. Weird group project all semester long which is just annoying. Not a hard class just annoying.

Do not, I repeat, do NOT take this prof for any classes she offers. She speaks in such a condescending tone and is really hostile towards questions. Unnecessarily harsh grading and unclear rubrics in addition to tons of homework make this class actually unbearable. She treats this class like it's worth 5 credits, DO NOT TAKE.

She treats you like a kindergartener, and annunciates too much, tedious semester long project along with frequent essays. Participation quizzes that have passwords you only get in class (not on uploaded slides) Way too many assignments when paired with other classes. AVOID HER!!! But it was pass fail so not insanely hard

Professor is not good at teaching, just reads off slides. Get ready to read on your own and do your ZyBooks legit as you will need it for quizzes, hw, and exams. She curves slightly which is good but try not to take her!

reviews.comment: She reads off the slides. If you have little to no coding experience do NOT take this professor. The TAs are literally better teachers than she is.
All the other professors curved a lot more and dropped more things but Dr. Schaefer only gave a very small amount of curve. I would recommend taking another prof.

Questions were heavily discouraged. One kid in my class asked a simple question and she looked at him like he said something vile. She answered in such a condescending tone, making it clear to not ask questions unless you wanted to be ridiculed.

She seems to not know the topic very well and isn't really a good lecturer. She also isn't that helpful, the TAs were a much better resource. She gives plenty of extra credit opportunities though, do the challenge problems and read the book before each quiz and you should get at least a B.

Engineering 102 has almost nothing to do with the prof, she's a good prof and will help you if you ask, but the exams will tank almost everyones grade to a B or C either way. Just do the extra credit challenge problems and all the participation and you'll do above average, which guarantees at least a B. She's also easy to work with for makeup work.

reviews.comment: She was a great professor I had zero knowledge of coding before I went into this class and still got an A. She was very willing to help if you had issues with your code. I feel like people give bad reviews because the class is difficult but she tried her best to help you understand this foreign topic.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had no coding experience and still ended up with a B+. Overall she isnt as bad as these reviews. Just stay on top of your work and you should be fine

reviews.comment: I honestly did not learn ANYTHING from her, everything was self-learning. She replied to my emails, and I hated how she made us "repeat after her" like we were children. Here lectures did not help at all. But lowkey I didn't get an A bc I just didn't do the labs. She only curved the class by 2 points.

Schaefer's lectures do not help apply to what you are quizzed on, and her quizzes are designed to fail. Her lectures aren't helpful and you are better to self teach yourself throughout ENGR102. If you don't have prior coding experience you will have trouble in this class. Schaefer makes very condescending comments and humiliates students in class.

She genuinely doesn't know what she is teaching. If you ask her a question, she cannot answer it. This is not an exaggeration!!  She reads off slides and that's it. If you want to learn, DO NOT take this lady! She would be an excellent professor for anything other than 102.

The quizzes are worth a significant amount of the final grade. The grading on the quizzes is designed for failure to the point it is technically possible to receive a negative score with the way the points are allocated. I emailed her regarding a test question at the end of the year and she replied snarkily and condescendingly.

I'm a straight A student, but I was on the verge of crashing out all semester. By far THE WORST 102 Prof. If you're new to coding, it's gonna be way too fast for you to absorb anything. She isn't understanding at all; I submitted a lab 1 minute late and she still docked me off 25%. Studied my ass off, but at some point you lose hope. Good luck...

if you dont have coding experience dont take her. those without prior experience got by through the TA's which were super helpful in completing the classwork, but it really hurt when it was time for exams and quizzes. i had a decent level of coding so i scraped by, and got an a by the 11 point curve.

her lectures and examples didn't correspond well with the quizzes we'd have, especially on the questions where you had to analyze the code. the end of semester project instructions were quite vague, and zybook lab assignments were rather time consuming. there are much better profs to be stuck with if you have no prior python exp

Professor Schaefer's lectures were largely unhelpful and she wasn't engaging or helpful at all. Her quizzes are 100% designed for students to fail, with 102 already being a weedout class for ETAM. She is condescending and ridicules students who ask questions. An A is possible, study hard for your midterm and final, and do well on quizzes.
Way more work then the course was worth, but it is pass/fail so no stress to score perfectly. Huge semester long project with lots of components and somewhat vague instructions.

Condescending and doesn't know her material very well, so don't bother even bother asking her anything. Also, she just reads off of slides... If you have the misfortune of taking her, I advise that you go the the T.A.s' office hours, they are the best. I never coded in my life and nearly got an A-, so she is manageable to be stuck with I guess.

reviews.comment: She's probably the worst professor I have ever dealt with in my 3 years of college. She Treats everyone like we're in Junior high and she clearly doesn't have any coding knowledge. I was really good at coding prior to this class so it didn't really matter at all for me. The only thing I have to say is my section got a 17 point curve on the entire grade so I can't complain.

Please DO NOT take her. She is the worst professor to ever exist I'm not even kidding. When you ask for help, she says "Oh, it's out of my paygrade. I'm just a mechanical engineer" and she will literally not help you, in fact her TA's know more than her. RMP guidelines says I should give pros and cons but there are literally no pros to her class.

Singlehandedly made me drop out of Engineering. Knew 2 languages coming into this class, including some basic Python. Lecture material and ZyBooks did not match the quizzes, of which there was one every week. Office hours were not useful whatsoever, and the lectures were simply read word for word. 
TAs were awesome though.

Truthfully she is an average professor. The first half of class will be a slideshow over information that is not always relevant to the work you will be doing, and the second half should be used on the weekly group assignments. Schaefer does allow extra credit (very little but I guess if you have a 89.4 it will help).

reviews.comment: She treats everyone like we are in middle school and makes everyone read slides like we are in elementary school. She says she will curve than not, and it is confusing. Take someone else!
Curved.

THIS IS A TERRIBLE PROFESSOR!! I took coding all 4 years of high school, knew 3 languages, and got a C in this class. Her office hours were no help either, as she had no clue what the f she was talking about. TAs were good though.

She does not know any coding and just reads straight up from the slides. Only did good cause I did Java in highschool so my brain knew how to work for coding. The TAs are more helpful than her. She is the ONLY professor that does not curve at all, other professors add a whole letter grade to their curve. DONT TAKE HER IF YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY.

I got an A only because I coded in high school. Horrible professor that didn't curve the final (average of 55 out of 100). I asked a question and she just told me to look at the lecture slides even though the answer was not in the slides. Her TAs were more helpful and actually answered questions.

Speaks extremely condescendingly despite her lack of programming knowledge. Reads word for word from lecture slides, usually can't even explain them. Can't answer questions, is extremely unavailable. The issue with the curve is that as people drop out, the average increases and there is no longer a curve. You have to rely on TAs and self-studying.

Just a really bad experience overall, and doesn't even provide much coding background either. She has her quizzes formatted terribly, and her overall teachings go straight off of the slides instead of engaging with the students. More could be learned from the textbook itself than this teacher, and when asked for help, doesn't really help at all.

I can not even put into words how awful this professor is. All she does in class is read off the slideshow that she didn't even make, and when anyone asks for help, she doesn't know how to answer their question. During office hours, she was extremely rude and clearly did not want to help, and the help she gave was not even useful. DO NOT TAKE!!!

reviews.comment: Horrible Professor. Horrifying lectures where all she does is read off of  PowerPoints.All the other professors drop a quiz and give out bonus points while she does neither. reviews.comment: Maybe the worst teacher I've ever had. Extremely difficult to approach and very condescending despite having no knowledge on the material we are tested over. There were several instances where I'd ask her about ways to fix my coding, and she would tell me that was above her paygrade. Avoid her at all costs.

Lectures are terrible. She does not know python well. You will have to teach yourself all the material. Review material is not helpful for exams. Quizzes every week, but makeups are not difficult to do as long as you have an excused university absence.

Do not take this professor for the love of god. She doesn't know how to teach the material, all she does is simply read off the slides, this class is and will be 100% self thought. All the material is due fridays when every other professor gives weekends to turn in material. Curve was promised but so many people dropped the class, so no curve.

I managed to do good in the class because I had prior programming knowledge but for those who are coming in with little to no programming knowledge this class is terrible. She's not the best at explaining topics which makes it difficult for people to learn. Additionally, she makes everything much more difficult than every other 102 proff.

Only professor that I know of that didn't give a curve, even though it was promised. Almost no opportunities for extra credit and recommended anyone with a D or below to Q drop rather than give out solutions to bring their grade up. Take any other professor.
ABSOLUTE BUNS OF A PROFESSOR DO NOT TAKE

reviews.comment: Take anyone but her. All the other 102 professors are giving out curves while she promised a curve and decided not to.All her quizzes are on lockdown and her lectures are awful.

Grading is really strict when it comes to quizzes or pdfs submitted for team labs.Told people to qdrop even when they could've passed. Not good about giving feedback.

she promised me a curve at the start of semester. Yet, because everyone who wasn't doing good in the class dropped, the average went higher and she said she won't curve. TAKE ANY OTHER 102 ENGINEERING PROFESSOR. Every other professor is curving and cropping quiz grades.
